balls.text: nails the yorker, and I am glad to see them try a second even though they have hit it straight to deep midwicket. Doesn't make it, but I am perplexed why other batters don't try it
closer to getting the yorker right. Dug out to leg for one
wide low full toss, and David again manipulates it. He breaks his back leg, gets low and drives it hard over point and fine of deep cover

high full toss but not high enough to be called. Gets big on him, and he ends up slicing it over extra cover. The two tall men make it an easy three. The batters have reviewed it for a no-ball. More than anything, it catches them a breather after running those three. It is below waist so let's get on with it
goes short and quick, pulled down to long-on for one
superb manipulation of the field. He shuffles across, and sweeps a low full toss from outside off to square leg for four
Green is not expecting a bouncer. Bhuvi delivers just that. Delayed attempt to ramp it. Beaten. Bhuvi has bowled his two death overs for just 14 runs and the wicket of Varma. Sensational bowling
lovely bowling. Not letting him get under it. Low full toss driven to long-on for one
slower ball, wide outside off, Green down the track to drive it to long-off for one
cue ends a pull to a wide short ball. Gets the single to long-off
low full toss, just outside off, driven wide of long-on for two
think this is not a slower one. Cramps him up as he advances down the pitch. Just the single to deep midwicket
low full toss, on leg stumps, Green takes the single to long-on and keeps the strike
goes one better now. Wide length ball, stands tall, golf-swings it over long-off. Nailed it

the field changes with one extra man going deep on the off side. Green successfully anticipates it, and chips down the wicket to hit this wide full toss to deep point for four. That's his maiden IPL fifty
there are long-on and deep midwicket but he has managed to place this in between. Natarajan misses a yorker, bowls a half-volley. Flicked in the air and into the gap
smacked away. All power. Short of a length, outside off, Green stands tall, and comes down on it with brute force. Beats extra cover
misses the yorker. Full toss hit straight to deep midwicket. Gets away with it
slower ball, full outside off, driven down to long-off
Markram is a livewire. Driven on the up, to the right of extra cover, and he dives full length to deny them a run
short of a length, no room, defended back to him

clever bowling from Bhevneshwar. A third knuckle ball in the over but this time he goes shorter. Varma is advancing at him but the angle takes the ball away, and he toe ends it to deep cover. A stunning cameo on a difficult pitch

sweet sound off the bat, and he has got just enough in it. This is a wide slower ball, but he has slogged it into the leg side. Gets a lot of height on this, which will worry him, but he has just cleared long-on
wide, full, slower ball, driven down to long-off for one
pushed wide of long-off for two
what wrists really. Markande again tries to cramp him up but this time he stands his ground and sweeps. And again the wrists send it sailing over long leg for six
bottom edge as he looks to push this down to long-on. The umpires want to check if it has bounced off his boot to the keeper. No. Off the shin, into the ground, and then to the keeper
stunning shot. Makes room, markande follows him, but with a whip of the wrists, he drives it over extra cover. What wrists
wrong'un, middle and off, pushed back to him
pushes this one wide. Too wide
slower in the air, punched to deep cover for one

misses the yorker by inches, and Varma has hit a six. Special batting. Stays deep in the crease, bends low, gets under it, and lofts it back over his head. Just enough in it to clear the fielders converging from long-off and long-on
offcutter, in the slot, and is swung away over square leg. Rare loose ball from Jansen. He has pitched it right in his wheelhouse
yorker this time, wide outside off as he sees him shuffle. Driven to extra cover
another short-ball offcutter, but he has managed to place this pull shot between deep square and deep midwicket. Along the ground
slower bouncer again. Green looks to get inside the line and pull. Beaten
nicely played. Green makes room, Jansen follows him with a short ball, but even from a cramped position he gets enough bat on it to clear short third
Varma makes room, Markande follows him, he tries to sweep but is early into it and is beaten
works this into a gap deep on the leg side, and a wider throw facilitates the second
looks to pull, but is early into it. It rolls back to the bowler off the front edge
forward press, but Markande cramps him up again. Defended back to him
reverse sweep, gets enough of the bat to clear short third. Gets four for his troubles
the rare legbreak from Markande. Cramps him up
punched to long-off for one
quick offbreak, punched down to long-on for one
pushed through wide, crunched away past extra cover for four
Washington sees him step out, slips in a wide one, and he has throw his bat at it and hope he gets some bat on it. Gets an outside edge. Falls short of short third
pulled between long-on and deep midwicket for two
drives along the ground, straight to mid-off
bouncer to welcome Varma. He is beaten on the top edge as he looks to help it along with the pull

Markram is a catching factory. Two excellent catches in one over. Cutter from Jansen, Surya ends up checking his drive, lobbing it wide of mid-off, and Markram runs to his left before diving full length to take this
they have two men just for that shot but he still clears them. Gets inside the line and plays the flamboyant flick-whip over long leg. Uses Jansen's pace
Green makes room, Jansen follows him and cramps him up, still cut away to square third for one
flicked to backward square leg for one

and he has taken a wicket first ball. Superb catch from Markram. Jansen sees Kishan is charging at him because the mid-off is up, and he goes into the pitch, draws the edge with the extra bounce, but it is sailing over wide mid-off. Markram runs back, sees it drop over his shoulder, and then puts in a dive to claim the catch. Excellent effort

it is a mis-hit but it has cleared the tallest man on the field. Oh he hasn't. Incredible effort from Jansen. He goes airborne to catch it one-handed and then flicks it back just a millisecond before his foot lands beyond the rope. Saves four runs
misses the yorker, bowls a low full toss, concedes just the single to long-on
slight width, and he punches it to deep cover for one
on a length, top of off, pushes this to deep point for another single
on a length, on off, pushed to long-off for a single
wide length ball, driven square on the off side for one
looks for the pull, another wrong'un, and he ends up slicing it well short of long-off for one
cut away to deep cover
makes room to try to slog-sweep, but is done in by the wrong'un. The top edge falls short of short third
this time he keeps some distance between himself and the pitch of the ball. Hits it hard back over the head of the bowler for four
incredible shot. Reverse-sweep, powerfully hit over short third, but ends up yorking the boundary. A bit of a top edge but he has hit so powerfully that it clears the infield.
chips down the wicket, gets too close to the ball, and drills it along the ground back to Markande
the first boundary since the powerplay. Green had to take the risk at some point. Jumps out of the crease, gets this offbreak in his wheelhouse, and lofts him over long-on
slightly short of a length, punched wide of long-on for two
pushed through, no turn, beats his outside edge on defence
hit hard into the pitch, Washington jumps overhead to field it
punches this length ball down to long-off
turn there. Also stopping. Kishan can only defend it back
wrong'un, cut away to deep cover for one
another swipe, this time an inside edge for a single
big swing and a big miss. Looking for the slog sweep but is playing for the turn. Markande, though, hardly turns it. Beaten on the inside edge
Kishan goes deep into the crease to pull but still can't get all of it. Just the single to long-on
leading edge. This is angling into the pads so perfectly understandable to play it to leg, but it stops on him. The edge sails over the bowler's head
short of a length, no turn, punched straight to extra cover
quick, on off, looks to drop and run, but Green sends him back as it has gone quickly towards short third
drives this but there is turn away, and he has to check the shot. Played straight to extra cover
punched down to long-on for another single
full and straight, driven to long-on for one
slight turn, defended with an open face to point
short of a length, punched straight of deep cover for two
slower ball, fuller, Kishan still goes for it, ends up dragging it square on the leg side. Agarwal runs to his right from long leg, puts in a dive, but still drops it. A lot of ground made
finally gets a hold of one. Stands in the crease, and pulls him over midwicket. Only slightly short of a length. No transfer of the weight either
another knuckle ball. This one swings away too. Takes the toe end on the big off-drive. Goes to short third
Kishan chips down the wicket, Bhuvneshwar drags the length back, Kishan opens the face for a single
looks for the big cover-drive, gets an inside edge to midwicket for one
Green charges at him, Bhuvneshwar seems to have bowled the knuckle ball, and Green is beaten
yorker, middle and off, dug out
punches one hard but for a single to cover-point

clear signs the ball is holding up. Has happened the second time this over. Sharma is looking to flick it into the leg side, and gets a leading edge to mid-off. Another breezy RGS innings but he would love for one of these to go on longer. Replays show Natarajan has bowled the slower offcutter. So well done, TN
the ramp shot now. From well outside off. Just a turn of the wrists to make sure it goes wide
shortens the length, the ball holds in the pitch. Defended outside off
and is welcomed with a smack over mid-on. Stands his ground, clears the front leg, and goes in the air
yorker, on off, dug out back to him
short of a length, wide, the perfect ball for the cut, but his feet are stuck on the leg stump. Beaten
he has taken out Rohit Sharma. Drills a half-volley back down the ground. Too quick for Rohit to get out of the way. Hit on the top of the pad
proper old-fashioned swipe. Nothing pretty but mighty effective. Well over wide mid-on for four
stays in the crease, turns a length ball around the corner to square leg for one
swing and a miss. Sharma jumps down the wicket to try to hit him over wide long-on but is beaten by the extra bounce of Jansen
some turn there. Kishan has to abort any ideas of an attacking shot. Defends with an open face
this one turns into the pads, and he nudges it to short fine for one
slows it down, gets some turn, and RGS hits it straight to cover-point
he is toying with the field. This time he makes room and cuts a flat length ball between point and cover-point
6000 IPL runs for Sharma. That last shot has created a short ball, and Sharma is expecting it. uses his wrists to make sure he goes square of deep midwicket
doesn't matter if it is the bigger side, doesn't matter if he has two men back. Sharma makes sure he sweeps him fine and plays it in the air. Well over short fine leg for four
top edges a hook but it doesn't matter. Te ground is not big enough to hold in top edges off a full-blooded hook off the pace of Jansen
looks to swing big at a length ball. Beaten. hit on the pad. Headed down leg
short of a length, outside off, runs this down to deep third
pushes this wide, Sharma throws his bat at it, misses, but gets a wide
pitched up, no swing, driven hard, but straight to mid-off
Kishan strides forward to a length ball, and steals a single to mid-off
on a length, slight shape away, played with an open face
Sharma walks at him, and Bhuvi doesn't react. Bowls another wide inswinger, and he drives it over cover-point for four
inswinger again. Headed towards top of middle. Defended to leg
another inswinger, this one starts wide outside off. Pushed to cover
inswinger. Rohit looks to flick it over square leg but is beaten. Headed down leg, though
short of a length, angling away, Kishan runs it down to deep third, who is quite square
slight shape away, lovely push-drive wide of mid-off for one
first wicket for Tendulkar in the IPL. SRH bowled out. Misses the yorker by inches, Bhuvneshwar tries to go down the ground, but gets an outside edge to extra cover. What a moment for Tendulkar jr.
he shuffles across looking to sweep but Tendulkar stays with the yorker. Hits his back pad for a leg-bye
yorker, on off, played with an open face to deep point
this is just too wide. Kishan does well to deny them extras on top of the wide
wide yorker again, toe-ended to deep point, and he runs himself out taking a non-existent second
looks for the yorker, gets in a low full toss outside off. Samad gets a nick on it, but Kishan saves four with a dive to his right
reversing yorker. On leg stump. Dug out into nthe stumps at the non-striker's. Samad doesn't take the single off the ricochet. He wants the strike
still reversing. Beats the inside edge on the slog. Half a shout for lbw but this is sliding down
goes short as expected, runs this down to deep third for one
nails the yorker. Follows him too as he backs away. Dug out back to him
oh Green is lucky. He is sliding down leg, and is lucky there is no bat on this because fine leg is up. One leg-bye only
inswing, on a length, top of off. Opens the face for. single
how many half-edges will go past short third tonight? Behrnedorff bowls well enough, gets an outside edge on this near yorker, but the third is inside the circle. anything past him is four

lazy running. Two yorkers in one ball. Behrendorff bowls one, and Washington digs it out for what looks like a comfortable single to mid-off. David lets a throw rip, catches the stumps on the yorker, and Washington is casual. Not even stretching his arm fully let alone diving
well is there another twist left? Back to two a ball now. Behrendorff looks to tuck him up with a yorker, but ends up going down leg. And Kishan can't catch up with nit
slower ball, on a length, but gives him the width, which allows Washington to open the face and beat short third
yorker, on off stump, dug out for a single to long-off
goes to good length, driven to deep cover for one
yorker gone wrong. Nice knee-high full toss, and he chips it over extra cover for four
slower ball, completely done in, but the miscue lands well short of long-off
and now he is back to the yorker. Dot ball as he digs it out back to the bowler
another catch for David. Meredith sees the yorker has a small margin for error, and goes short and slow. Jansen has no choice but to go four a boundary every ball. Ends up skying it to long-on
lovely shot. He has missed the yorker only by inches, and he drives it back above his head with a high elbow for the pose. Bisects long-off and long-on
nails the yorker. On leg. Dug out for one
goes for the inswinging yorker. Overcooks the line. Wide down the leg side
swing and a miss as Meredith comes back
yorker, spot on, but Jansen gets the outside half of the toe end on this, and it squeezes past short third for four lucky runs
misses the yorker, and Jansen gets low to hit this half-volley straight of long-off for four
looks for the yorker, short by a few inches. Pushed to extra cover for one
outswing. remarkable bowling. I think it is reversing, and he is playing with the shiny side. Yes definite reverse. Beats the outside edge. The shiny side on the outside
another yorker. Perhaps slightly fuller than one. It tails away this time to beat his outside edge
spot on with the yorker, Jansen squeezes it out for one to point
beaten on the inside edge. Seams in off a length, and beats the inside edge. Kishan dives to his left and gets a hand to it

another catch for David. Meredith misses the yorker, but the low full toss is good enough, especially when it follows Agarwal and takes his arms away from him. He can manage to send it to long-on for an overhead catch, which David smartly takes
yorker again, but wide down the leg side
yorker, and follows him as he backs away. Just the single to deep square leg
on a length now. Punched to deep cover for one
another yorker on the money. Dug out for a single. There is some tail here
yorker again, and right on the money. Dug out back to him

he looks to hit a six off the back foot. It is a wrong'un, which he has read here, but again it comes slowly off the surface and takes the toe end of the bat. David runs to his left and forward from long-on to take a well-judged overhead catch
looks to defend with a flat shortish delivery but Klaasen picks the length early and manufactures a pull here. And he ends up going wide of deep midwicket
and now a reverse-swept six. Again shows it early, again ends up going squarer than he wants but he has timed this well. Middled it
the biggest six of the night. Flat, quick, and right in the slot. Looks like a seam-up delivery. Klaasen has bludgeoned it over Chawla's head for a huge six
legbreak. Some turn too. And Klaasen is down for a reverse early. Gets a toe end. Looking to go over short third but ends up going over point
Chawla follows him as he comes down the track and looks to make room. There is no pace to work with. He lofts it to deep square leg for one
misses the yorker by inches, but goes only for a single to deep midwicket as Agarwal is hit on the inside half of the bat. I could be wrong, but I suspect it might be reversing
yorker again. Swinging in. Is it reversing? Dug out for a single

big appeal for lbw on the yorker, not given, and they have reviewed it. Agarwal has shuffled across, but the umpire reckons it is sliding down. First replay suggests he might be right. Beaten on the inside edge but it is missing leg. MI lose both their reviews
slower short ball, pulled to long leg for one
shows him the ramp early, Green goes for the slower ball, but he is good enough to delay the shot and manages to clear short fine
hits him high on the bat with a length ball, but he has managed to place it between square leg and long leg for a couple
slows this one down, Agarwal runs it behind square but straight to short third. With that, the required rate goes past two a ball
looks for a slog into the leg side, but is beaten on the inside edge. Headed down leg, though
superb shot. Flighted outside off, and drills this wide of long-off for four. All along the ground
short of a length, goes back to pull this to deep midwicket
legbreak, outside off, punched to deep cover for one
wide legbreak, skips down the wicket, drives to deep cover
on a length, just outside off, pushed to cover
he has smacked this pull. Short again, but this time outside off, Stands tall and goes over midwicket. Right out of the screws
short ball, down the leg side, called a wide. Kishan appeals again, but he won't be able to convince Rohit to go upstairs this time
slower ball as Agarwal backs away again. Just the single to long-on
keeps the pull down for a single to deep square leg
gets inside the line to work this to deep square
Agarwal backs away, Meredith follows him with a length, and he punches it down the ground. Gets superb timiing on it. Beats long-on
wrong'un, punched to deep midwicket for another single
pushes this through, Klaasen hits it down to long-off for one
another legbreak. This one turns too. Defended in front of off
legbreak, full, middle and leg, worked to deep square
wide on the crease, pushes one through, punched to deep cover

seems to have picked the wrong'un but still doesn't get enough power in the shot. He is possibly looking to go over cover, but the googly doesn't turn that much, and takes the inner half of the bat for a simple catch to long-off
wicket to wicket, on a length, pushed to short midwicket
on a length, wicket to wicket, pushed to mid-on for one

Green is turning everything to gold. Markram clears the front leg and slogs, but I suspect it is the slowness off the surface that draws the miscue. Toe-ended to deep midwicket. Huge wicket in this SRH line-up
on a length, on top of off, runs this down to deep third for a single
wide down the leg side, Kishan is appealing, and he has convinced Sharma to ask for a review. And they have wasted the review. The ball is near nothing. neither the bat nor the glove nor the pad
on a length, wicket to wicket, swiped to deep square leg for one
starts off with a short ball that doesn't get big on him. Pulled through square leg for four
Sharma might just have saved three there. Chawla goes flat and short, he cuts it in front of square, and a big dive from Sharma keeps them to one
goes back to punch this wide of long-on, and they steal the second again
slider again, quicker one, pulled to deep square leg
Agarwal down the wicket, gets close to its pitch, and lofts him back over his head for four
wider on the crease, looks like a slider, flatter in the air. Pushed down to long-on again
on a length, legreak, pushed to long-on for one
gets the shorter ball now, and cuts it to deep cover for two
Shokeen is not giving them anything to hit so Markram dances down the wicket to create one. Lofts him over midwicket for a clean six. Just the right space between him and the pitch of the ball
punched to deep midwicket for one. Shokeen stays out of the driving arc without bowling too short
slower in the air, still not a half-volley, uses soft hands to work this into a gap on the leg side for a couple
on a length, outside off, no turn, pushed back to him
and there is immediate turn for him. Cramps him up, but they squeeze in a single
on a length, on leg, worked to square leg for another single
looks like a cutter, 133ks, short of a length, beats him attempt to go over mid-off
looks to go over mid-off, gets a thick edge to deep cover
full and straight now, clipped straight to midwicket
cleverly played. On a length, gets some width, and opens the face to guide it between short third nad backward point for four
on a length, punched straight of mid-off for one
backs away. Meredith follows him. Manages to swipe it over the infield, comes back for two
back to top of off. Defended
shades of the Agarwal of old. Slower ball, picks it, and plays half-sweep-half-pickup over square leg for a six
on a length, punched to mid-off, and they take on the tall left-arm seamer Behrendorff for a quick single
full and straight, punched to mid-on
on a length, angling in, hits the thigh pad as he looks to work this away to leg
short of a length, tucked away off the hip for one
on a length, on off, defended from the crease
Behrendorff is on fire. On target, just around off, and on a length. Tripathi is looking to run it down because the big shot is not on. The angle takes the edge, and MI have two early wickets
pushed wide of mid-on for another single
on a length, stump to stump, Tripathi drops and runs for a single
on a length, on the pads, worked to leg for a single
nicely played. Tendulkar goes short of a length, doesn't give him much room, but Tripathi opens the face and guides this between short third and point. Gets four
on a length, on the pads, dragged to deep square leg for one
another wide down the leg side
short of a length, on off, run down to short third for one

anticipates Tripathi will make room, slips in a wide down the leg side, but a big shout from Tendulkar and Kishan makes the umpire go upstairs. That means the umpire reckons he has nicked it, but the bump ball needs to be checked. In the process, though, the umpire will get the edge checked too. That is clever umpiring in the face of a big appeal. Replays confirm what I first said: big wide down the leg side. Bat nowhere near
pulled away to deep square for one
now he denies him any room with one short of a length. Another dot
smartly bowled. Sees Agarwal make room, and slips one in wide outside off
cut away to deep third for one
short of a length, outside off, runs this down to deep third for one
short ball, cramps him up, and draws the top edge. This is not a slower edge, and it is at his shoulder. Brook is surprised by it. Looking to hit it still, and the edge settles at cover-point
sumptuous. Push-drive on the up. Threads the needle between cover-point and cover. Replay this a hundred times
Agarwal is looking to advance, Behrendorff goes shorter and follows him. The mis-hit gets him a single to mid-on
on target, top of off. Defended
well bowled. Brook is making room, and he follows him with a slower bouncer at 107ks. Brook manages to cut it down but straight to point
looks like a slower one. Bowled at 123ks. On a length, Brook opens the face to short third
Brook is disdainful now. Gives him some width, and Brook dances down the track to drive Tendulkar over extra cover
on a length, tight line again, some shape, 127ks. Clipped away for one
shape back in again. Even from short of a length. Brook opens the face and takes a single
inswinging low full toss. Kept out by Brook. Surprised a touch by the length
